nodes.label: .claude/hooks/enforce_source_allowlist.py (PreToolUse hook)
nodes.rationale: Governs tool choice: stops any agent from reaching for the open web (WebSearch/WebFetch/curl/wget) instead of the approved corpus. Deliberately kept independent of the MCP server's own allowlist check, since the hook cannot see inside the corpus.

nodes.label: Retrieval/precision evaluation harness (stretch, not built)
nodes.rationale: Not built since it needs a labeled query set, which is beyond a 3-source, 12-document demo corpus; would evaluate Recall@10, Precision@10, Citation Coverage, and Hallucination Rate.

nodes.label: evidence-mcp-server / evidence_mcp_server.py
nodes.rationale: Governs its own data independently of the PreToolUse hook: even inside the approved corpus, one document (BLG-999) has approved:false in allowlist.json, so get_document/search_corpus refuse to surface it. The hook can't see inside the corpus and the corpus check can't see a WebFetch attempt, so both layers are necessary.

nodes.label: Phase 1 ingestion metadata schema
nodes.rationale: confidence_weight (0.0-1.0) is only the per-document source-quality input to the confidence-scorer's formula, not a substitute for confidence scoring itself - one of four weighted factors.

nodes.label: patent-agent / patent source_type (stretch, not built)
nodes.rationale: Patents are deliberately out of scope for this POC per the original plan ('avoid patents initially to reduce complexity') - no patent-agent and no patent source_type exist in the corpus; listed as a stretch item for a future phase.

nodes.label: Weighted confidence-scoring formula
nodes.rationale: confidence_score = 0.30*retrieval_score_avg + 0.30*source_quality_avg + 0.20*cross_source_agreement + 0.20*recency_score, fixed so scoring is deterministic and auditable rather than improvised per run; an override caps a claim at Low if its only support is a stale internal_report or a trial with no results yet.

nodes.label: Context-and-memory policy (key_points-only extraction discipline)
nodes.rationale: Retrieval agents extract only 3-6 key_points bullets from full document bodies and never return the full body to the caller, keeping what crosses into the supervisor/synthesizer's context small and summary-only; a verbatim detail needed later is re-fetched by evidence-synthesizer itself rather than pre-emptively returned.

nodes.label: Hybrid keyword+vector search with recency re-ranking
nodes.norm_label: hybrid keyword+vector search with recency re-ranking
nodes.rationale: Kept as one call site inside search_corpus (no separate re-ranking MCP tool) to keep the POC's retrieval layer minimal per the plan's reduced Phase 1-2 scope; Azure AI Search / text-embedding-3-large is the intended production replacement, not built here.

nodes.label: Retrieval boundary vs. corpus allowlist (two distinct layers)
nodes.norm_label: retrieval boundary vs. corpus allowlist (two distinct layers)
nodes.rationale: The PreToolUse hook governs tool choice (open web vs approved corpus); the MCP server's own allowlist governs its own data (excludes BLG-999 via approved:false). Neither layer can see what the other catches, so removing either on the assumption the other covers it is unsafe.

nodes.label: graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS if unsure); never skip the corpus-size warning; always show token cost; never hide cohesion scores; never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning.

nodes.label: OTel span/metrics instrumentation of ui/server.py
nodes.rationale: Traces only the boundary the project owns: a manual helios.run_pipeline span per /api/ask request tagged with pipeline status, a helios.pipeline.requests_total counter, and a helios.pipeline.duration_ms histogram - not inside the pipeline itself, since each subagent runs in its own separate `claude` CLI subprocess context with no in-process call graph to trace.
